scope: Prospective targeted external test; one fixed custom forest, fixed threshold and previously specified exception. No fitting, threshold selection, family selection, rating features, deployment or general tooling.
forest: Exact selected fullfit custom forest from previous study. Bothwindowminimum score; inherited eligible/confidence/physicalknown guards.
candidate: baseline forest award OR (exact base_rule AND saved nonmate_material_win==0 in BOTHwindows). Anyunknown abstains. No removal of existing baseline awards.
engine: SF18 existing pinned binary; Threads1Hash64MultiPV2 nodes300000, current/previous completed same-depth windows, fullPGNhistory; clearhash/newgameperposition. Same feature extractor as earlier standard studies.

sampling.source: Existing public monthly PGN caches; exclude all previously studied/reviewed/reserved gameIDs and seen before/after positionfirst4fields. Exclusion manifest frozen before mining. No labels used to select or order.
sampling.mine: Deterministic sha256 game order, chronological actual played moves; any qualifying nonpawn-piece capture after move permitting actual immediate mate reply. Up to4000freshgames/400rawcandidates/600wallseconds, whichever first. No synthetic turnnewness filter; inheritedrule handlesattribution.
sampling.inference: Up to400rawcandidates, deterministic sha256 caseorder;900secondwall cap; only completedcasesincluded, partialexplicit.3coreposition searches then exact75features. Acceptingbranch searches for base_rule matches only;<=4offers. Fixed settings no retries.
sampling.review: Up to12new-award candidates ordered by casehash and up to12nearby nonawarded structuralmatingoffers fromdistinctgames. Prioritize base-rulepass material-veto/unknown controls, then minimize categorical mismatch (capture/check/queenoffer/movedoffer) and numericdistance(bestscore/100,gap/10,prior score/100); greedydeterministic tiescasehash. If fewernewawards, includeall plus up to12controls. If0newawards, review first12base-rulepass candidates or closest structuraloffers for diagnostic coverage; no expansion.
sampling.freeze: Freeze all scoredcases and exact reviewqueue/hash BEFORE any new Chess.com label read. Retain all queued results, unresolvedlabelsreported, no result-based topup.
sampling.label: Chess.com GameReview TorchHuman/Fast currentaccount settings read-only. Exacttargetmove fromsamepublicgame; no inventedratings. OriginalgameReview first; importoriginalPGN onlyifnormalUI cannotopen. Do not changepreferences.
sampling.unit: Whole game one reviewtarget pergame; reject crossgame duplicated targetpositions. No newfolds or retraining: priorgroupeddevelopment design preserved, prospectiveexternalgames fully heldout.

reporting: Paired baseline vs candidate TP/FP/FN/TN, incrementaltrue/wrong awards, allqueuedcases. Targetedcasecontrol sample cannot estimate population recall/precision or prove<1%wrong. KeepdiagnosticknownNe5 excluded. Report binomial uncertainty fornewawards; do notdeclarezeroFPpopulation guarantee.
stop: No outcome-driven tuning, retries, threshold variants, newfamilies or sampletopups. Any operationalproblem stop expansion and report minimalblocker.
